interface.shortDescription: Ten focused workflows for agent initialization, plans, memory, root-cause simplification, systems paper writing, and architecture paper review.
interface.longDescription: A ten-skill engineering workflow pack for grilling and refining ideas, creating implementation plans with inline requirements and optional specs, planning brief changes, handing off sessions, initializing agent instructions, maintaining project memory, and simplifying code and project-memory documentation, plus writing evidence-grounded systems papers and reviewing architecture papers with separate issue and expert reports.
